findings.detail: scene 2: must_say 6 «ask when you should meet again» — slot «the time» is what the answer names (time)

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: You are meeting your son's teacher at school because there have been behavior problems. This is the first serious discussion of what has been happening in class or during breaks, and you need to understand the teacher's concerns clearly before deciding what to do next.
Learner: Parent. Partner: Teacher.
Not in this scene: agreeing on a plan at home and school, consequences, follow-up dates, contact methods.
must_say: give your name and your child's class — slot: the class
say why you asked for the meeting — slot: the concern
ask what behavior the teacher has noticed — slot: the behavior
ask when and where it usually happens — slot: the moment or place
answer whether there were similar problems before — slot: the time or situation
ask how serious the problem is at school — slot: the area (lessons, breaks)
ask what may be causing it — slot: the possible cause
confirm you understand the main concern — slot: the concern
must_understand: asks who your child is and which class they are in
says what behavior has been a problem at school
explains when and where it usually happens
asks whether this has happened before or at home
says how serious the issue is and what may be behind it

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: After the problem is clear, you continue with the same teacher to agree on practical next steps. What matters here is coordinating school and home, understanding any consequences, and knowing how progress will be monitored so the situation does not get worse.
Learner: Parent. Partner: Teacher.
Not in this scene: identifying the behavior itself, when and where it happens, possible causes of the problem.
must_say: ask what the school is doing now — slot: the measure
ask what you can do at home — slot: the action
ask whether there will be consequences — slot: the consequence
ask how progress will be checked — slot: the method
explain what support your child already has — slot: the support
ask when you should meet again — slot: the time
ask how to contact the teacher — slot: the contact method
confirm what you both will do next — slot: the next step
must_understand: says what the school has already tried or will try
asks what support or rules the child has at home
explains whether there will be consequences or warnings
tells how progress will be monitored
gives a time for follow-up and a way to stay in contact
